title: Service mesh: Istio, Linkerd and Envoy

videos.script: Every signal in this course so far was produced by code somebody wrote into the shop. A service mesh produces some of them without asking. {{mesh}} It puts a proxy beside every service, and every request goes through it. So the proxy can count, time and secure traffic the code never mentions. {{proxy}} You start with Envoy, the proxy most meshes are built on, in front of the storefront. Then between orders and payments, where it retries failed charges. The customers stop seeing errors, and the metrics change their meaning. {{retries}} Then Istio on Kubernetes. Sidecars are injected into every pod, traffic is encrypted, and each request is labelled with who sent it. {{istio}} And finally the question every team should ask first. What does all this cost, and when is it worth it? {{cost}}
